item.disasters.disaster_controller.toolt: Right-click to open the disaster control panel
gui.disasters.title: Disaster Control Panel
gui.disasters.intensity.tooltip: Click to change the intensity (size, duration and power)
message.disasters.no_permission: You need to be an operator or in creative mode to use this
message.disasters.too_many: Too many active disasters. Stop some first
disasters.disaster.black_hole.desc: A floating singularity that pulls in and destroys everything
disasters.disaster.tsunami.desc: A giant wave that sweeps away everything in the direction you look
disasters.disaster.tornado.desc: A wandering tornado that lifts entities and rips up blocks
disasters.disaster.meteor.desc: A single meteorite falls from the sky and explodes
disasters.disaster.meteor_shower.desc: Many meteorites rain down over an area
disasters.disaster.volcano.desc: A volcano rises from the ground and erupts lava and magma bombs
disasters.disaster.blizzard.desc: Freezing snowstorm: slowness, freezing and ice everywhere
disasters.disaster.flood.desc: Water rises over the whole area and then recedes
disasters.disaster.earthquake.desc: Shakes the ground, collapses buildings and opens deep fissures
disasters.disaster.thunderstorm.desc: Dark skies and constant lightning strikes
disasters.disaster.hailstorm.desc: A big cloud rains 3D chunks of ice over the area
disasters.disaster.fire_rain.desc: An ember-red cloud rains burning rocks that explode on impact
disasters.disaster.sinkhole.desc: The ground collapses into a deep funnel, swallowing trees and houses
disasters.disaster.nuke.desc: Flash, shockwave, giant crater and a mushroom cloud. EXTREMELY destructive
gui.disasters.random.tooltip: Unleashes a random disaster with the selected intensity
disasters.disaster.halley_comet.desc: A 3D comet with a glowing tail crosses the sky and crashes: crater, ice around the impact, and the ice melts into real water 20 seconds later
disasters.disaster.wormhole.desc: A tunnel with an entrance and an exit about 100 blocks away. Whatever enters is safely transported to the exit
disasters.disaster.hypothetical_black_ho: Hypothetical black hole connected to a white hole: it pulls and absorbs, and the white hole appears elsewhere and ejects everything it received
message.disasters.no_safe_destination: No safe destination was found: nothing was absorbed
disasters.disaster.mars_collision.desc: Mars appears in the sky and falls toward the Earth. The impact devastates a configurable area
disasters.disaster.hurricane.desc: A huge moving funnel with storm clouds: lifts creatures and objects and tears up weak blocks
disasters.disaster.heat_wave.desc: Scorching sun and distorted air. Exposure builds up: weakness, slowness, heat damage and fires
disasters.disaster.freeze_wave.desc: A blue-white energy wave freezes creatures and covers the ground with temporary ice
disasters.disaster.ufo_invasion.desc: A UFO abducts creatures with its beam, fires energy rays and drops hostile aliens
item.disasters.laser_pistol.help: Right-click: shoot. Sneak + right-click: change beam color
message.disasters.laser_empty: Out of energy! You need an Energy Cell
